roots.name: cloud-drives
roots.note: Includes sarah/ as of 2026-08-07 (Matt lifted the earlier exclusion explicitly). Origin is the first path segment, so her files stay filterable as origin='sarah'.

roots.name: inbox
roots.note: storage-pool/backups/inbox — a Google Drive export (My Drive/Downloads) holding documents that exist nowhere else in the corpus.

roots.name: mac-sync
roots.note: Dev-tree backup: source is knowledge but is already in git, so it is keyword-only (embed:none). Vendored deps, build output, and tool caches are excluded entirely. Worktrees are excluded globally in sources.mjs.

roots.name: git-mirrors
roots.note: Disabled for Phase 1 (CONTRACT.md deviation, see pipeline report): bare mirrors under this root are git object stores, not working files -- indexing them as flat text would surface raw pack/object garbage with no commit/PR context. Phase 2's git connector (services/pipeline connector or a dedicated worker) reads these properly via `git log`/REST instead. The exclude patterns above are kept so that if this root is ever flipped to enabled:true before Phase 2 lands, .git directories and bare-repo internals (objects/refs/hooks/info/branches/logs, *.git dirs) are still never opened.
